inputs.source: 226,650 new US lung cancers in 2025 (SEER), about 85% of them non-small cell, the pool the volrustomig and savolitinib seeds use
lung cancer incidence is the pool: diagnosed and treated each year rather than accumulated

three filters multiplied: 55% advanced or metastatic at presentation (the volrustomig seed's share); 15.2% EGFR-mutated among tested US patients with advanced NSCLC (Subramanian et al., Lung Cancer 2025, doi:10.1016/j.lungcan.2025.108412: 1,914 of 12,577); and 60.6% going on to a second line after first-line osimertinib (Kodama et al., Thorac Cancer 2025, doi:10.1111/1759-7714.70192: 57 of 94). 0.55 x 0.152 x 0.606 = 0.0508, about 9,800 patients a year

inputs.unit: share of the untreated pool per year
inputs.source: solved: the share that brings the build's unrisked peak to $4bn, the top of the $2bn to $4bn peak sales Bank of America Securities gives sacituzumab tirumotecan after its Phase 3 lung win (Yahoo Finance, 'Merck's Sacituzumab Tirumotecan Data Reframes Outlook For Oncology And Valuation')

Keytruda, Merck's own infused oncology medicine and its closest marketed analogue: FY2025 sales outside the US of $12,812mm against $18,829mm in the US (asset_revenue_regions, SEC financial statement data sets), a ratio of 0.680

price.source: Trodelvy, CMS Medicare Part B 2024: $272,318,588 over 3,300 beneficiaries, $82,521 a beneficiary. Trodelvy is sacituzumab govitecan, the TROP2 ADC already sold in the US and the closest comparator on file

Social Security Act section 1847A: Medicare Part B pays 106% of average sales price, and ASP is already net of manufacturer discounts and rebates, so the manufacturer's price is the CMS figure divided by 1.06, which is 5.66% below it

valuation.name: Sacituzumab Tirumotecan
valuation.loe_basis: Merck FY2025 10-K (0000310158-26-000063), key U.S. patent protection for drug candidates in Phase 3 development, compound patent; the table notes these may be subject to a future PTE of up to five years, not taken (2040)

gate.label: Phase 3 readout
gate.basis: implied, not published: the stated PoS of 73.5% over the 95.2% the asset carries if its Phase 3 readout passes gives gate odds of 77.3%, against 48.3% published; a failure is taken at nil, the model's convention for a failed programme

held.note: A miss leaves 12 other Phase 3s open; the model's own rule would hold it at 44%, but the stated PoS governs until it is cleared.

next_catalyst.title: Phase 3, Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (MK-2870) in Post Platinum and Post Immunotherapy Endometrial Cancer (MK-2870-005)

valuation.launch_source: Merck 8-K exhibit 99.1 of 4 August 2026 (0001104659-26-090045): the phase 3 TroFuse-005 trial met its primary endpoints of overall survival and progression-free survival in endometrial cancer after platinum and anti-PD-1/L1 therapy. The FDA had already awarded sac-TMT a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher, which Merck says gives an opportunity to expedite review (8-K exhibit 99.1 of 3 February 2026, 0001104659-26-009495). A 2026 readout plus the time to file and launch gives a first full year in 2027
